title: VCPS evidence record
description: Structural schema for .vcps/evidence/EVD-*.md frontmatter. Owned in content by standard/evidence-model.md SS4 (VCPS-EVD-030). This file is a NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06 from the intact Core text, not a recovery of any prior schema bytes -- see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

assertion.description: The precise, falsifiable statement being evaluated (glossary.md 'Assertion').

method.description: Command, test identifier, procedure, or inspection method. Executable evidence (E2+) MUST include a reproduction command or procedure (VCPS-EVD-030).

scope.description: Repository-relative files/components/paths the assertion is actually about.

summary.description: Required (VCPS-PORTABILITY-004) when type is external and this evidence backs a gate/lifecycle promotion: a durable excerpt so the record stays interpretable if the external locator becomes unreachable.

does_not_prove.description: Per VCPS-EVD-021/VCPS-LVL-020/021: what this substitute cannot be used to prove about the real target.

related.description: Other evidence/finding/gate record IDs this bears on.

corrections.description: VCPS-EVD-060: a correction creates a new record linked by supersedes_ref; the prior record is never edited.

then.description: VCPS-EVD-001/templates/validation.md item 6: E0 CLAIMED cannot support a gate PASS.

identity.description: Whatever stable identity the environment provides (VCPS-EVD-032). No specific vendor/model/agent identity format is required.

revision.description: glossary.md 'Revision'. A committed revision is a VCS content hash. A dirty-worktree revision (VCPS-EVD-052) MUST be reconstructable by content hash/manifest, never a bare timestamp.

oneOf.description: A VCS commit hash (or equivalent immutable identifier).

manifest_hash.description: Content hash of a manifest covering every changed/untracked file in scope, per VCPS-EVD-052.

manifest_ref.description: Repository-relative locator for the manifest itself, if persisted.
